apps.manifest:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
x-nex:
  name: Arr Suite
  summary: Integrated movies, TV, music, subtitles and downloads
  description: Seven single-copy services with separate settings and one shared /data tree. Configure authentication,
    indexers, clients and providers after installation.
  category: media
  scalable: false
  options:
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric UID with write access to all selected folders.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric GID with write access to all selected folders.
    TZ: Time zone
    DATA:
      label: Shared media and downloads
      help: One writable /data tree for every media service and downloader. Create movies, tv, music, torrents and
        usenet subfolders. Keep config databases on host storage for the first lab test.
    RADARR_CONFIG:
      label: Radarr settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    RADARR_PORT:
      label: Radarr web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
    SONARR_CONFIG:
      label: Sonarr settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    SONARR_PORT:
      label: Sonarr web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
    PROWLARR_CONFIG:
      label: Prowlarr settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    PROWLARR_PORT:
      label: Prowlarr web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
    LIDARR_CONFIG:
      label: Lidarr settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    LIDARR_PORT:
      label: Lidarr web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
    BAZARR_CONFIG:
      label: Bazarr settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    BAZARR_PORT:
      label: Bazarr web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
    QBITTORRENT_CONFIG:
      label: Qbittorrent settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    WEBUI_PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Published port, container port and WEBUI_PORT change together. Keep CSRF and host-header checks enabled.
    TORRENTING_PORT:
      label: TCP peer port
      help: Published and container peer ports change together. TCP only; current Core cannot publish the same number
        for UDP as well.
    SABNZBD_CONFIG:
      label: Sabnzbd settings
      help: Persistent private /config; must be writable by PUID/PGID. Use This host for initial lab database testing.
    SABNZBD_PORT:
      label: Sabnzbd web port
      help: Choose an unused published HTTP port; keep authentication enabled.
services:
  radarr:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/radarr:6.4.4.10685-ls326@sha256:51a9ac2a9eb47afc833541e5fd6c11b86eb9f810694c22fa2429e3078e9194b2
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    ports:
    - ${RADARR_PORT:-7878}:7878
    volumes:
    - ${RADARR_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  sonarr:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.20.3014-ls4@sha256:673dc4609a5672bc8e46069c86ffcea283a86b48d34a6c93d8da8c24a1b87571
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    ports:
    - ${SONARR_PORT:-8989}:8989
    volumes:
    - ${SONARR_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  prowlarr:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:2.7.0.5723-ls168@sha256:6660787a99b2e58203539583663c973b48979fc00ff2cb78dc0ea17429e1f6ef
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    ports:
    - ${PROWLARR_PORT:-9696}:9696
    volumes:
    - ${PROWLARR_CONFIG}:/config
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:3.1.6.5079-ls48@sha256:a91ef0642c15c9bd7c4260fee98fa99972c61601e37c8a96411d6a9cf0e9ad40
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    ports:
    - ${LIDARR_PORT:-8686}:8686
    volumes:
    - ${LIDARR_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:v1.6.2-ls372@sha256:832820dec70bce9e912c6eee7a95baf6551e03dbc63325a7208daaa455423752
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    ports:
    - ${BAZARR_PORT:-6767}:6767
    volumes:
    - ${BAZARR_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  qbittorrent:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:5.3.0_v2.1.2-ls487@sha256:3d4c4545d51a690a0df15a2ff99038823a88a9822df8e794526447b9afbd7384
    ports:
    - ${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}:${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}/tcp
    - ${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}:${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}/tcp
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
      WEBUI_PORT: ${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}
      TORRENTING_PORT: ${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}
    volumes:
    - ${QBITTORRENT_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first
  sabnzbd:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:5.1.3-ls281@sha256:b356d0a9b22db584e9005364ec4e752dfc081ce501b7145e9a5c0bb38e4d1ba4
    ports:
    - ${SABNZBD_PORT:-8081}:8080/tcp
    environment:
      PUID: ${PUID:-1000}
      PGID: ${PGID:-1000}
      TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
    volumes:
    - ${SABNZBD_CONFIG}:/config
    - ${DATA}:/data
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first

# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
x-nex:
  name: Bazarr
  summary: Find subtitles for movies and television
  description: >-
    Subtitle companion requiring Sonarr or Radarr and matching media files. Select the same existing DATA folder on a share for integration, or use arr-suite.
  category: media
  website: https://www.bazarr.media
  source: https://github.com/morpheus65535/bazarr
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  scalable: false
  options:
    CONFIG:
      label: Settings storage
      help: Persistent settings and database. Keep writable by the selected PUID and PGID; prefer This host for the database.
    DATA:
      label: Movies and television
      help: Media and writable subtitles under /data/movies and /data/tv. Select the same existing folder on the same share as Sonarr/Radarr for shared media.
    PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Use an unused port. Configure application authentication before allowing access beyond a trusted network.
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric owner of the application files. Ensure both selected folders are writable by this user or group.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric group of the application files. Share permissions must allow this group to write.
    TZ:
      label: Time zone
      help: IANA time zone used for schedules and logs, for example Etc/UTC.
services:
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:v1.6.2-ls372@sha256:832820dec70bce9e912c6eee7a95baf6551e03dbc63325a7208daaa455423752
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-Etc/UTC}"
    ports:
      - "${PORT:-6767}:6767"
    volumes:
      - "${CONFIG}:/config"
      - "${DATA}:/data"
    deploy:
      replicas: 1

  license: GPL-3.0-only

    CONFIG:

    DATA:
      label: Music and downloads
      help: Music and staged downloads under /data/music and /data/downloads. For shared media, select the same existing folder on the same share in each app.
    PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Use an unused port. Configure application authentication before allowing access beyond a trusted network.
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric owner of the application files. Ensure both selected folders are writable by this user or group.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric group of the application files. Share permissions must allow this group to write.
    TZ:

services:

    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:3.1.6.5079-ls48@sha256:a91ef0642c15c9bd7c4260fee98fa99972c61601e37c8a96411d6a9cf0e9ad40
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"

    volumes:

# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
x-nex:
  name: Prowlarr
  summary: Manage and synchronize search indexers
  description: >-
    Manage indexers and sync them to reachable applications over their APIs. No media or download folder is needed.
  category: media
  website: https://prowlarr.com
  source: https://github.com/Prowlarr/Prowlarr
  license: GPL-3.0
  scalable: false
  tags: [indexers, automation]
  options:
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric UID used by the application. Both storage and any imported files must be writable by this UID or the selected group.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric GID used by the application. Match the group allowed to write its storage; Nex does not grant these permissions automatically.
    TZ:
      label: Time zone
      help: IANA time zone name, such as Etc/UTC.
    PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Published HTTP port. Set up application authentication before allowing other users to connect.
    CONFIG:
      label: Configuration
      help: Persistent settings, database and credentials at /config. Must be writable by the selected UID/GID; back up this folder.
services:
  prowlarr:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:2.7.0.5723-ls168@sha256:6660787a99b2e58203539583663c973b48979fc00ff2cb78dc0ea17429e1f6ef
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-Etc/UTC}"
    ports:
      - "${PORT:-9696}:9696"
    volumes:
      - "${CONFIG}:/config"
    deploy:
      replicas: 1

# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
x-nex:
  name: qBittorrent
  summary: Standalone BitTorrent downloads with a web interface
  description: Store torrent state and downloads in separate Nex-managed folders. One copy only; incoming peers use TCP in this package.
  category: downloads
  website: https://www.qbittorrent.org/
  source: https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  scalable: false
  options:
    WEBUI_PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Published port, container port and WEBUI_PORT change together. Keep CSRF and host-header checks enabled.
    TORRENTING_PORT:
      label: TCP peer port
      help: Published and container peer ports change together. TCP only; current Core cannot publish the same number for UDP as well.
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric owner of application files. Both selected folders must be writable by this UID and the group below; share ACLs and root squash still apply.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric group for application files; match the selected folders' write permissions.
    TZ:
      label: Time zone
      help: IANA time zone, for example Etc/UTC.
    CONFIG:
      label: Settings and torrent state
      help: Persistent /config, including credentials and resume state. Use reliable writable storage; back this up as well as downloads.
    DATA:
      label: Downloads
      help: Writable /data for save and incomplete paths. To share downloads, select the same existing folder on the same share in each app.
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:5.3.0_v2.1.2-ls487@sha256:3d4c4545d51a690a0df15a2ff99038823a88a9822df8e794526447b9afbd7384
    ports:
      - "${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}:${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}/tcp"
      - "${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}:${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}/tcp"
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-Etc/UTC}"
      WEBUI_PORT: "${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}"
      TORRENTING_PORT: "${TORRENTING_PORT:-6881}"
    volumes:
      - "${CONFIG}:/config"
      - "${DATA}:/data"

# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
x-nex:
  name: SABnzbd
  summary: Standalone Usenet downloads, repair and unpacking
  description: Configure a Usenet provider in SABnzbd and keep incomplete and completed downloads under /data. One copy only.
  category: downloads
  website: https://sabnzbd.org/
  source: https://github.com/sabnzbd/sabnzbd
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  scalable: false
  options:
    PORT:
      label: Web port
      help: Published TCP port; the application still listens on container port 8080. Complete initial setup on a trusted network and enable authentication.
    PUID:
      label: User ID
      help: Numeric owner of application files. Both selected folders must be writable by this UID and the group below; share ACLs and root squash still apply.
    PGID:
      label: Group ID
      help: Numeric group for application files; match the selected folders' write permissions.
    TZ:
      label: Time zone
      help: IANA time zone, for example Etc/UTC.
    CONFIG:
      label: Settings and queue
      help: Persistent /config holds provider credentials, API keys and queue state. Use reliable writable storage and protect backups.
    DATA:
      label: Downloads and unpacking
      help: Writable /data for temporary and completed downloads; allow room for unpacking. To share downloads, select the same existing folder on the same share in each app.
services:
  sabnzbd:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:5.1.3-ls281@sha256:b356d0a9b22db584e9005364ec4e752dfc081ce501b7145e9a5c0bb38e4d1ba4

    volumes:
